stem: A worker lifts a light container hundreds of times from floor level to a bench. Why is object weight alone an incomplete risk measure?
choices: Light loads become heavy only after four hours
Frequency, reach, starting height, posture, grip, and duration also shape manual-handling demand
Only the worker's age determines whether repetition is acceptable
The load is low risk whenever it can be lifted with one hand
rationale: Ergonomic exposure depends on combinations of force, posture, repetition, duration, reach, and coupling rather than weight alone.
